title: Missing PizzaCraft Recipes
description: Adds missing crafting recipes from PizzaCraft by Tiviacz1337
body:
Adds **Missing PizzaCraft recipes** like:

- **tomato, cucumber, pepper, pineapple, broccoli seeds** that are craftable (not just from tall grass)

Just pop em in the crafting table and Voila!

Also you can now craft **hot chicken wings**, you craft them like this:![hot_chicken_wing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4963bfcc59dddfbd066629b872a2018c2e9a331.png)

I also want to add olives that drop from olive trees (since they don't no idea why) but Im dum as hell and can't figure it out xd

- PizzaCraft: [https://modrinth.com/mod/pizzacraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/pizzacraft)
- CurseForge: [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/missing-pizzacraft-recipes](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/missing-pizzacraft-recipes)
